api: parseBuffer(Uint8Array, { mimeType: 'audio/mpeg', size }, { duration: true }) -> IAudioMetadata.format (codec, sampleRate, numberOfChannels, bitrate, codecProfile, numberOfSamples, duration); parseFile(path) and parseStream(Readable, { mimeType: 'audio/mpeg' }) checked equal by api-check.js
coverage: Node V8 source-range coverage of music-metadata lib/ during parseBuffer replay of the valid control. parser_source_lines_covered counts every executed lib/ line, including module evaluation of the ~30 format parsers the package imports and its ID3v1/ID3v2 probes; format_specific_source_lines_covered counts lib/mpeg/MpegParser.js only (sync, frame loop, side-information skip, Xing/Info probe, EOF duration). Jazzer.js instrumentation for the fuzz entry is limited to lib/mpeg/.
coverage_limit: Untagged MPEG Layer III only; two valid CBR controls do not establish VBR, Xing/Info/LAME, free-format, Layer I/II, MPEG-2.5, ADTS, ID3 or CRC-protected support. MpegParser walks frame headers and skips side information; it does not decode audio. duration: true is required for a full frame walk; without it the parser reads four frames and estimates CBR length from file size.
